data.gender_notes: Ravat is used as a masculine name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ravat is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ravana', which means 'Sun' or 'Power'. In Hindu mythology, Ravana is the king of Lanka and a powerful demon king who was a formidable adversary of Lord Rama. Ravat is a name that evokes strength, courage, and the power of a warrior. The name Ravat carries the meaning “Sun, Power, Hero” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Ravat usually hope their child will grow to embody sun, power, hero and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ravat is a name that represents the inner power and strength of an individual. It is a reminder of the divine power that lies within each of us, and the courage and determination needed to overcome challenges and obstacles in life.
